title: Build Your Own CRM with AI: Replace Salesforce for $0/Month in Subscription Fees
summary: Salesforce charges $80/user/month. You only use 6 features. Here's how to build a custom CRM with AI that does exactly what you need — and costs a fraction.
body_markdown: Go to[blink.new](https://blink.new/) and describe your CRM. A strong starting prompt: "Build a CRM with contacts (name, company, email, phone, LinkedIn), a deal pipeline with stages Lead → Qualified → Proposal → Negotiation → Won/Lost, an activity log per deal, email templates, and a dashboard showing total pipeline value by stage and deals closing this month."
